Clock Minute Hand question, Class 10 board exam: find the area swept by a 14 cm minute hand in 5 minutes (a 30° sector).

• 60 minutes = 360°, so 1 minute = 6° and 5 minutes = 30°
• Area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr², with r = 14 cm
• (30/360) × (22/7) × 14 × 14 = (1/12) × 22 × 2 × 14 = 616/12
• Area = 154/3 cm² ≈ 51.33 cm²
